def fit(X, t, y):
    from scipy.optimize import nnls
    B = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(t), (t - t.mean()) / np.ptp(t)])
    w = np.ones(len(y))
    for it in range(20):
        Xw = X * w[:, None]
        Bw = B * w[:, None]
        yw = y * w
        q = np.linalg.qr(Bw)[0]
        Xp = Xw - q @ (q.T @ Xw)
        yp = yw - q @ (q.T @ yw)
        beta = nnls(Xp, yp, maxiter=3000)[0]
        b = np.linalg.lstsq(Bw, (y - X @ beta) * w, rcond=None)[0]
        r = y - X @ beta - B @ b
        s = 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r)))
        w = np.sqrt(np.minimum(1, 1.345 * s / np.maximum(1e-14, abs(r))))
    return (beta, r, b)
